title: 2012 Azorean regional election
text: The 2012 Azorean regional election was an election held on 14 October 2012 to elect the 57 members of the regional legislative assembly for Portuguese autonomous region of the Azores. The Socialist Party, under the leadership of Vasco Cordeiro won an absolute majority with 49 percent of the vote, while their direct rivals, the Social Democratic Party, achieved just 33 percent of the vote. Voter turnout was low with just under 47.9 percent of the electorate casting their ballot on election day.
